purpose: Response-blind qualification of the Florida Keys National Marine Sanctuary Seagrass Monitoring Project as an external test of Tampa quantitative early warning.
scientific_hypothesis: Among source-year permanent transects with recorded Thalassia presence, lower quantitative Thalassia state predicts next-year recorded loss beyond space/time/effort.

response_independent_sampling_semantics.program_name: Florida Keys National Marine Sanctuary Seagrass Monitoring Project
response_independent_sampling_semantics.permanent_unit: Level 1 stations are permanent/fixed sites sampled repeatedly; Level 2/3 sites are not eligible for the longitudinal endpoint.
response_independent_sampling_semantics.level1_frequency: quarterly in the FKNMS monitoring description
response_independent_sampling_semantics.transect_design: 10 random 0.25 m2 quadrats along a permanent/fixed transect
response_independent_sampling_semantics.braun_blanquet_zero_semantics: 0 indicates absence; positive categories range from solitary/sparse through 75-100% cover

candidate_data_source_if_qualified.preferred: SEACAR standardized SAV export for program 296, current version fixed before download
candidate_data_source_if_qualified.reason: Do not choose among raw provider files after seeing outcomes.

stop_rule: If the standardized metadata cannot establish the required fields and missing-versus-zero semantics before biological data access, stop v2 pre-response.
no_rescue: Do not inspect biological data values to infer schema.
Do not treat missing/null as absence.
Do not include Level 2/3 annually redrawn random stations in same-site transitions.
Do not change focal species, endpoint or primary predictors after biological data access.
